fields.name: license_tiers
fields.description: The named license classifications available under the statute for this profession.
fields.sample_quote: The division shall issue to an individual qualified under the provisions of this chapter a license in the classification of: (a) hearing instrument specialist; or (b) hearing instrument intern.

fields.name: intern_license_term_years
fields.description: The fixed term in years for which an intern-level license is issued.
fields.sample_quote: The division shall issue a license for a hearing instrument intern for a term of three years.

fields.name: board_certification_required
fields.description: Whether the applicant must hold current board certification (e.g., NBC-HIS) as a condition of licensure or renewal.
fields.sample_quote: have qualified for and currently hold board certification by the National Board for Certification - Hearing Instrument Sciences, or an equivalent certification approved by the division

fields.name: board_certification_body
fields.description: The name of the national certifying body whose credential satisfies the board certification requirement.
fields.sample_quote: board certification by the National Board for Certification - Hearing Instrument Sciences

fields.name: equipment_calibration_required_at_renewal
fields.description: Whether the licensee must demonstrate calibration of all technical instruments used in practice as a condition of license renewal.
fields.sample_quote: calibration of all appropriate technical instruments used in practice

fields.name: circuitry_type_disclosure_required
fields.description: Whether the licensee must disclose the circuitry type (digital or analog) of a hearing instrument in advertisements, presentations, and purchase agreements.
fields.sample_quote: failing to describe the circuitry in any advertisement, presentation, purchase, or trial agreement as being either 'digital' or 'analog'

fields.name: minor_patient_referral_required
fields.description: Whether the licensee is required to refer patients under a specified age to a physician or audiologist rather than testing and fitting them directly.
fields.sample_quote: refer all individuals under the age of 18 who seek testing of hearing to a physician or surgeon, osteopathic physician, physician assistant, or audiologist

fields.name: minor_referral_age_threshold
fields.description: The age below which a patient must be referred to another licensed provider rather than tested and fitted directly by the hearing instrument specialist.
fields.sample_quote: refer all individuals under the age of 18 who seek testing of hearing to a physician or surgeon

fields.name: trial_period_days
fields.description: The mandatory number of days a consumer has the right to cancel a hearing aid purchase and receive a refund.
fields.sample_quote: provide the consumer with a 30-day right to cancel the purchase if the consumer finds that the hearing aid does not function adequately

fields.name: cancellation_fee_max_percent
fields.description: The maximum percentage of total fees the seller may retain as a cancellation fee when a consumer exercises the right to cancel a hearing aid purchase.
fields.sample_quote: the seller of the hearing aid is entitled to a cancellation fee not to exceed 15% of all fees charged to the consumer

fields.name: written_informed_consent_required
fields.description: Whether the licensee must obtain written informed consent from the patient before providing services or products.
fields.sample_quote: obtain written informed consent from the patient regarding offered services, products, and the expected results of the services and products in a form approved by the division

fields.name: ada_assistive_listening_disclosure_required
fields.description: Whether the licensee must inform patients about hearing instruments compatible with ADA-compliant assistive listening systems before a sale.
fields.sample_quote: inform each patient who is being offered a hearing instrument about hearing instruments that work with assistive listening systems that are compliant with the ADA Standards for Accessible Design

fields.name: supervision_level_types
fields.description: The named levels of supervision defined in statute under which an intern may practice.
fields.sample_quote: 'Direct supervision' means that the supervising hearing instrument specialist is present in the same facility... 'Indirect supervision' means that the supervising hearing instrument specialist is not required to be present in the same facility

fields.name: supervisor_minimum_experience_years
fields.description: The minimum number of years of full-time practice required before a licensee may serve as a supervising hearing instrument specialist.
fields.sample_quote: has practiced full-time as a hearing instrument specialist for not less than two years

fields.name: indirect_supervision_practical_exam_required
fields.description: Whether a supervisor must pass a practical examination in hearing testing before being permitted to supervise an intern remotely (indirectly).
fields.sample_quote: receives a passing score on a practical examination demonstrating acceptable skills in the area of hearing testing as approved by the division

fields.name: exempt_professions
fields.category: who is exempt from needing this license
fields.description: Other licensed professions explicitly exempted from needing a hearing instrument specialist license to perform overlapping acts.
fields.sample_quote: an audiologist licensed under the provisions of Chapter 41... a physician and surgeon... osteopathic physician... physician assistant

fields.name: fixed_place_of_business_required
fields.description: Whether the licensee must maintain a regular physical place of business identified by street address.
fields.sample_quote: have a regular place or places of business from which the person conducts business as a hearing instrument specialist and the place or places of business shall be represented to a patient and others with whom business is conducted by the street address

fields.name: device_condition_disclosure_required
fields.description: Whether the licensee must disclose in writing whether a hearing instrument sold to a patient is new, used, or reconditioned.
fields.sample_quote: a statement whether any hearing instrument provided to a patient is 'new,' 'used,' or 'reconditioned' and the terms and conditions of any warranty or guarantee that applies to each instrument
